newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO APRIL SALES RISE 40.6 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: KESKO APRIL SALES RISE 40.6 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said in a statement on Thursday that group April sales excluding value-added-tax (VAT) rose 40.6 percent year-on-year to 3.46 billion markka.
Sales by the durable and semi-durable goods group surged 219 percent to 437.2 million markka, and sales by the hardware and agriculture unit increased 19 percent to 812.8 million, Kesko said.
International sales powered ahead 284 percent to 688.7 million markka, it said.
